title: Step into your calling
author: YWAM SF Communications
excerpt: Be trained. Be transformed. Be sent. DTS starting January 18 is your chance to live out your faith and impact the world around you.
seo_description: Be trained. Be transformed. Be sent. DTS starting January 18 is your chance to live out your faith and impact the world around you.
body:
What if the start of your year could change the direction of your life?

Join our next Discipleship Training School (DTS) for 5 months from January 18, 2027. It is an opportunity to step away from the noise and intentionally pursue God’s purpose for your life.

DTS is designed to help you grow in your relationship with Jesus in a real and personal way. Over the course of the program, you’ll dive into biblical teaching, worship, prayer, and community living. It’s a season to ask honest questions, build a strong foundation of faith, and discover your identity in God.

But DTS isn’t just about learning, it’s about living it out. After the lecture phase, you’ll step into outreach, where you’ll share God’s love in practical ways, both locally and internationally. Whether it’s serving communities, evangelism, or simply being present with people, you’ll see your faith come alive beyond the classroom.

San Francisco is a unique place to begin this journey. It’s a city full of diversity and creativity, and it needs a supportive environment to foster compassion and courage. You won’t just be trained; you’ll be challenged to engage with the world around you in meaningful ways.

You don’t need to have everything figured out to join DTS. All it takes is a willing heart and a desire to know God more deeply.

If you’re ready to take a step of faith, this is your moment.

Your journey starts January 18, 2027

Apply now and be part of what God is doing through YWAM San Francisco.
